Maya D.: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR to add concrete examples for quantization profiles + batching recommendations. PR: https://github.com/redwood/insights/pull/4321

Leo K.: Nice. Can you add a tiny SDK snippet showing how to set a quant_profile plus batch_size in the Optimize API? Most folks copy-paste and miss the `prefill` option.

Maya D.: Sure. Drafted one, PTAL: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.optimize(
  model='redwood/qlora-13b',
  quant_profile='q4_k_mixed',
  batch_config={'max_batch_tokens':2048, 'max_batch_size':8},
)
print(resp.suggestions)
```

Andre P.: Small nit — use `q4_k_mixed` without backslash escaping in the markdown. Also mention the latency tradeoff: q4_k_mixed saves ~2.5x token cost but may increase 95p latency on short requests.

Maya D.: Good catch. I'll fix the code block and add a note with a simple perf table. Any wording on the caching section? I added 'prefix caching' line but it's terse.

Samira (DevEx): For caching, can you include a quick example of enabling KV prefix caching in the deployment config? e.g.: 
```yaml
caching:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
```
And a short sentence — "use prefix_kv for repeated prompts where earlier tokens are stable".

Leo K.: Also add a cross-link to /optimize/faq about when not to cache (personalization, legal text). Few customers hit that.

Maya D.: Will do. Re: migration guide snippet — I added a before/after for SDK v0.7 -> 0.8; can someone sanity-check the param rename `quantProfile` -> `quant_profile`?

Andre P.: That's correct. Also show the human-readable warning: "Model fidelity changes possible after quantization — run evals against your prompt suite." Maybe link to our evals guide.

docs-bot: Deployment preview for PR #4321 is up at https://deploy-preview--docs.redwood.ai/optimize/quant-profiles — checks passed ✅

Maya D.: Awesome. I'll update based on comments and push a follow-up commit. If everyone can give a quick LGTM after that, I'll merge and then post in #announcements.

Samira (DevEx): Happy to review once updates are in. @Andre P. could you confirm the perf numbers you cited?

Andre P.: Yep — I'll paste a small CSV into the PR with the numbers and source commands.

Maya D.: Thanks all :rocket:
